name: cc-over
description: Claude Code mod: cross-session handoff bundles

compose.title: Compose mode
compose.description: How /over builds a hand-off bundle. fork: the conversation is summarised by one extra request to the session's model (after the prompt cache expires, that request is billed for the whole conversation prefix again). none: the intent plus git only, no model request.

history.title: Sent history
history.description: Keep a preview of each bundle you send (intent, summary, instructions, file paths, targets with their status, times; no Details, diffs or full text) in the plugin store, at most 50 per session and 14 days, and list it in bare /over and /over --history. Off: nothing new is saved and the list is hidden; entries already saved age out on their own.
